LESSON: LANGUAGE SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Language School

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Language School. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: howing doing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise correct use of (6 Lessons) statements and questions.
2. appreciate the importance of subject verb agreement for fluency. subjects at home .

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognise correct use of (6 Lessons) statements and questions.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognise correct use of (6 Lessons) statements and questions. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of subject verb agreement for fluency. subjects at home .
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of subject verb agreement for fluency. subjects at home . Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Language School.
2. Explain Language School to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners construct sentences using personal with you at it number and objects pronouns individually, in pairs or in small home? appropriately in groups 3) Who buys (6 Lessons) dialogues,
4. Show that you can: recognise correct use of (6 Lessons) statements and questions.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Language School. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: howing doing?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners construct sentences using personal with you at it number and objects pronouns individually, in pairs or in small home? appropriately in groups 3) Who buys (6 Lessons) dialogues,
2. Learners use pronouns in simple sentence you books? b) pick out personal constructions

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recognise correct use of (6 Lessons) statements and questions.
2. appreciate the importance of subject verb agreement for fluency. subjects at home .

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
